title: Your First AI Project: Pick a Useful Goal and Keep It Small | Ep 47
description:
Your First AI Project: Pick a Useful Goal and Keep It Small. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 47 of 50

What you will learn: Scope a useful project with constraints.
Example: a personal reading tracker.
Try it: write a one-page project brief.
Remember: avoid collecting unnecessary personal information.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
